summary: Feed s103_single to NDR is degraded: 94.6% encrypted bytes exceeds 90% tolerance for this NDR. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, packet drops, tool overload, missing VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 94.6% of bytes are encrypted (threshold 90%), indicating predominantly TLS 1.3/QUIC traffic forwarded without upstream decryption. NDR receives opaque payloads with no visibility into application content.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep packet inspection and behavioral detection. With ~95% encryption, it can only use flow metadata, significantly reducing detection coverage for malware, C2, and lateral movement.

recommended_fix.why: Deploy selective TLS decryption via packet broker integrated decryption or dedicated TLS visibility appliance and forward a decrypted copy to the NDR to bring encrypted share below 90% while respecting privacy/policy, restoring payload visibility.
